prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1131; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
text: The vehicle was inspected at the body shop following a sideswipe that occurred while changing lanes. The damage on the rear quarter panel and the adjacent door is largely consistent with the reported impact, showing a continuous path of scuffing, creasing, and paint transfer. A few small scratches lower on the bumper appear weathered and may predate this incident. The proposed repair plan covers panel replacement, refinishing, and blending to match the surrounding paint, and the labor hours listed fit the scope of the visible damage. The line items reviewed show no repeated charges.
